title: Long-awaited I-9 Form Update Released
description: USCIS released an updated I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification Form that should be used starting May 7, 2013.
body:
The US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) released an updated I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification Form. Employers are required to complete a Form I-9 to verify the identity and employment authorization of each employee hired in the United States.

The new form should be used immediately. The effective date to begin using the form was May 7, 2013. Employers who fail to properly complete and retain I-9 forms are subject to civil fines of up to $1,100 per form and, in some cases, criminal penalties.

The new Form can be found under Human Resources forms when you log in to your account. The forms are labeled: USCIS FOR I-9 (Employment Eligibility Verification) (Revised 3-8-2013). Contact us if you have any questions.
